spots.name: Nasir-ol-Molk Mosque
spots.summary: The Nasir-ol-Molk Mosque, also known as the Pink Mosque, is a mosque located in Shiraz, in the province of Fars, Iran. Completed in 1888 CE, the Qajar era mosque is located in the Gowd-e Araban district of Shiraz, south of Lotfali Khan Zand Street, next to the Shāh Chérāgh Mosque.

spots.name: Shah Cheragh

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Shah Cheragh is a Twelver Shia funerary monument and religious complex located in Shiraz, in the province of Fars, Iran. The 12th-century complex is centred around the mausoleums of Ahmad ibn Musa and Mir Muhammad ibn Mussa, two sons of the seventh Shia Imam Musa al-Kazim.

spots.name: Tomb of Hafez
spots.summary: The Tomb of Hafez, commonly known as Hāfezieh (حافظیه), are two memorial structures erected in the northern edge of Shiraz, Iran, in memory of the celebrated Persian poet Hafez. The open pavilion structures are situated in the Musalla Gardens on the north bank of a seasonal river and house the marble tomb of Hafez.

spots.name: Eram Garden
spots.summary: Eram Garden is a historic Persian garden in Shiraz, Iran. The garden, and the building within it, are located at the northern shore of the Khoshk River in the Fars province.

spots.name: Arg of Karim Khan
spots.summary: The Arg of Karim Khan or Karim Khan Citadel, is a citadel located in central Shiraz, Iran. It was built as part of a complex during the Zand era. It is named after Karim Khan Zand, and served as his living quarters. It is rectangular in shape and resembles a medieval fortress.

spots.name: Vakil Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Vakil Mosque is a Shi'ite mosque, located in Shiraz, in the province of Fars, in southern Iran. The mosque is situated to the west of Vakil Bazaar and adjacent to the entrance of the bazaar.

spots.name: Tomb of Saadi
spots.summary: The Tomb of Saadi is a tomb and mausoleum complex dedicated to the Persian poet Saadi, commonly known as Saadieh. The complex is located in the city of Shiraz, in the province of Fars, Iran.

spots.name: Qavam House
spots.summary: Qavam House, also known as Narenjestan-e Qavam, is a Qajar era house and garden in Shiraz, Iran, built between 1879 and 1886 commissioned by the Qavam family.

spots.name: Qur'an Gate
spots.summary: Qur'an Gate or Shiraz Gate is a historic gate in the north of Shiraz, Iran. It is located at the northeastern entrance of the city, on the way to Marvdasht and Isfahan, between Baba Kouhi and Chehel Maqam Mountains near Allahu Akbar gorge.

spots.name: Vakil Bazaar
spots.summary: Vakil Bazaar is a bazaar in central Shiraz, Iran.

spots.name: Afif-Abad Garden
spots.summary: Afif-Abad Garden, originally the Gulshan Garden, is a museum complex in Shiraz, Iran.

spots.name: Vakil Bathhouse
spots.summary: Vakil Bath, Wakil Bath, or Wakil Hammam is a Zand era public bathhouse (hammam) in Shiraz, Iran. It was a part of the royal district constructed during Karim Khan Zand's reign (1751–1779) which included the Arg of Karim Khan, Vakil Bazaar, and Vakil Mosque, among other administrative buildings.

spots.name: Pars Museum
spots.summary: The Pars Museum is a museum in Shiraz, Fars province, Iran. Founded in 1936 under Reza Shah Pahlavi, it is located in Nazar Garden.

spots.name: Atiq Jameh Mosque of Shiraz

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Ancient Congregational Mosque of Shiraz is the oldest mosque of Shiraz, the capital of Ostane Fars in Iran. Dating from the earliest part of the 9th century Persian Renaissance following the capture of Shiraz from the Abbasid Caliphate, it was built over a pre-existing religious compound, most likely a fire temple.

spots.name: Jameh Mosque of Qiblah

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Jameh Mosque of Qiblah is a mosque in Kukherd city, the capital of Kukherd District in Bastak County, in the province of Hormozgan in southern Iran. The mosque is situated to the west of the Sibah Bazaar, next to its entrance.

spots.name: Delgosha Garden
spots.summary: Delgosha Garden is a historic garden near the Tomb of Saadi in Shiraz, Iran. It belongs to the pre-Islamic Sasanian era.

spots.name: Tomb of Bibi Dokhtaran

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Tomb of Bibi Dokhtaran, also known as the Bibi Dokhtaran Mausoleum, is a mausoleum located in Shiraz, in the province of Fars. Iran. The complex was built during the Ilkhanid era.

spots.name: Tomb of Ali ibn Hamzah, Shiraz

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Shiraz is the fifth-most-populous city of Iran and the capital of Fars province, which is historically known by the exonym Persia proper. As of the 2016 national census, the population of the city was 1,565,572 people, and its built-up area with Sadra was home to almost 1,800,000 inhabitants.

spots.name: Adel Yazdi Gallery

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Adel Yazdi Gallery House is located in the historic district of Shiraz, in the Qavam House neighborhood. This gallery house was founded by Adel Yazdi, an Iranian artist and sculptor, with the aim of transforming the city's old texture into a cultural center and promoting art.

spots.name: Tomb of Khwaju Kermani
spots.summary: Tomb of Khaju Kermani is the tomb of the Persian poet and Sufi mystic Khaju Kermani (1290–1349). It is located north of Shiraz, on Sabooy hill off the Shiraz–Isfahan road. It is in Allahu Akbar Gorge. His grave overlooks the Qur'an Gate. Roknabad spring passes near the tomb.

spots.name: Shahrdari Square
spots.summary: Shahrdari (Shohada) Square is a square in Shiraz, Iran where Hejrat Street, Piruzi Street and Zand Boulevard meet. The Shiraz Municipality building, Arg of Karim Khan, and the main court of Shiraz are near this location.

spots.name: Abnun Fire Pot
spots.summary: Qavam House, also known as Narenjestan-e Qavam, is a Qajar era house and garden in Shiraz, Iran, built between 1879 and 1886 commissioned by the Qavam family.

spots.name: Saraye Moshir
spots.summary: Caravansary at the south entrance of Bazaar Vakil, which now functions as exhibition space for Iranian handicrafts.
